title: Hessian-Similar Optimization with Capped Participation: Lower Bounds and Virtual Masters
abstract: arXiv:2610.33835v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: What is the round complexity of Hessian-similar optimization when each round can contact at most $s$ of $m$ clients? Prior rates permit a free master or full participation and do not characterize strict caps. We count every one-vector query and reply. A hidden-client chain gives a lower bound for zero-respecting local algorithms with adaptive cohorts and random stopping: on strongly convex quadratics, the required rounds are $\Omega((m/s)\sqrt{\min\{\delta_a,\bar\delta/\sqrt m\}/\mu}\,\log(1/\epsilon))$ for $s\leq(m-2)/2$ in the high-accuracy, high-dissimilarity regime. Here $\mu$ is strong convexity, while $\delta_a$ and $\bar\delta$ bound anchor and average Hessian variation. To remove dependence on a poor anchor, virtual-master SVRS uses independent estimator and proximal cohorts and averages the proximal replies. With Catalyst, it reaches relative gap $\epsilon$ in $\tilde O(m/s+(\sqrt{m/s}+m^{3/4}/s)\sqrt{\bar\delta/\mu})$ expecte

translated_title: 参与受限的Hessian相似性优化：下界与虚拟主节点
translated_abstract: 当每轮最多只能联系m个客户端中的s个时，Hessian相似性优化的轮次复杂度是多少？已有的速率结果允许免费使用主节点或要求完全参与，并未刻画严格的参与上限。本文对每一次单向量查询与回复进行计数。通过隐藏客户端链的构造，本文为采用自适应队列与随机停止的“零尊重”局部算法给出了下界：在强凸二次函数上，当s ≤ (m-2)/2且处于高精度、高差异度情形时，所需轮次为 Ω((m/s)√(min{δ_a, δ̄/√m}/μ) log(1/ε))，其中μ为强凸性参数，δ_a与δ̄分别刻画锚点Hessian变化与平均Hessian变化的界。为消除对较差锚点的依赖，虚拟主节点SVRS算法采用相互独立的估计器队列与近端队列，并对近端回复取平均。结合Catalyst加速技术，该算法可在期望 Õ(m/s + (√(m/s) + m^{3/4}/s)√(δ̄/μ)) 的轮次内达到相对误差ε。
tldr: 本文在每轮严格限制参与客户端数量的设定下，为Hessian相似优化建立了轮次复杂度下界，并提出虚拟主节点SVRS算法以消除锚点依赖，实现近最优的收敛轮次复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes round-complexity lower bounds for Hessian-similar optimization under strict per-round client participation caps, and proposes a virtual-master SVRS algorithm that removes anchor dependence and achieves near-optimal round complexity.
